placement.title: Placement test
placement.intro: About {n} questions across A1, A2 and B1. It takes ten minutes and suggests where to start.

level.A0: Start from unit 1: you are a beginner, and that is the plan.
level.A1: You have the basics. Start at the beginning of A2 to fill the gaps, or skim A1 first.
level.A2: Solid everyday Italian. Start at the beginning of B1.
level.B1: You are at B1 or above. Use the B1 units as a review, then the grammar reference.

placement.empty: The placement test is being written.

home.heroIntro: The whole story is told through the character you choose. You can switch anytime in settings.
home.heroMDesc: He moves from Toronto to Roccamarina.
home.heroFDesc: She moves from Toronto to Roccamarina.
home.selfQ: When exercises are about you, which form should they use?
how: Read the story with the translation hidden, then listen to it line by line.
Study the words out loud with the audio, then flip through the flashcards.
Work through the grammar: rule, table, typical mistakes.
Do the exercises until you miss few, then come back tomorrow for the flashcards.

landing.kicker: A free, original course · Italian ⇄ English
landing.title: Two shores, one story.
landing.lede: Learn Italian as Luca or Lucia, who leaves Toronto for a town in Puglia. Learn English as their cousin Chiara, who moves to Toronto. Same cast, same engine, two directions. A1 to B1, free, no account.
landing.enDesc: Explanations in English. Luca or Lucia moves to Italy.
landing.itDesc: Spiegazioni in italiano. Chiara si trasferisce a Toronto.
landing.f1: 24 units per course, A1 to B1, built on the CEFR can-do goals
landing.f2: A story told through the protagonist you choose, with every line adapting
landing.f3: Audio on every word and line, flashcards, a verb trainer, a placement test
landing.f4: Progress saved in your browser; nothing to install, nothing to sign up for

footer.about: Due Sponde · Two Shores is a free, original course. All stories, examples and exercises were written for this site.
